extraction.Name: Josephine Collins
extraction.Buyer: W. B. Tackett (purchased a quarter section of land in Gregory County)
extraction.NOTES: Letter dated July 2, 1929, from W. B. Tackett of Wood, S.D., to Supt. E. S. McKean of Rosebud, S.D. Josephine Collins claims she did not receive all of the purchase price for a quarter section of land in Gregory County. Tackett denies the accusation and states she received every cent agreed upon. Also references a similar claim by one Peter Bordeaux. Tackett states he met Mrs. Collins and her husband at least fifty times since the transaction without any such claim being raised; met Mrs. Collins the previous month at Winner Hospital. Tackett states he is unable to locate any relevant documents locally but may have something in Omaha. | TASK 5 CAT_3 BACKFILL 2026-05-04 (patents database): Allotment 2862.5 sourced from federal-register-app patents database (Christian's research, 2026-05-04). CAT_3 record — Sonnet text extraction captured the allottee Name but not the Allotment number; this patch backfills the allotment.
